description.value: De l'Île Restaurant is a small dinner-service restaurant on Vancouver Island, operating out of 129 Second Avenue West in the Vancouver Island & Gulf Islands region. The associated website has evolved into a food and travel blog alongside a digital recipe store, suggesting a chef-driven operation with interests spanning Italian cuisine, wine, and amaro. For touring cyclists, it offers a sit-down dining option in a community not saturated with evening restaurant choices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a restaurant at 129 Second Avenue West with phone and website confirmed by the URL match. The website is active with blog posts dated December 2025, but its content is entirely a recipe store and food/travel blog — no menu, no reservations, no address, and no phone number appear anywhere on the site, making it impossible to confirm any amenity claims or contact details beyond the domain itself. All required and optional amenity fields default to null due to absence of evidence.
